summary: Verified fix for stays search bar input-focus bug (SearchBar.jsx mobile sheet + stays/ui.jsx Modal). Independently reproduced the originally-reported scenario and confirmed focus is retained across multi-character typing and Backspace deletions on both mobile (390px) and desktop (1440px). Regression-tested modal open/close via Escape key and X button, and completed the end-to-end stays search flow. Fix in /app/frontend/src/stays/ui.jsx (storing onClose in onCloseRef and reducing effect deps to [open]) is working as intended.
critical_code_review_comments: stays/ui.jsx Modal useEffect omits onClose from deps intentionally (ref pattern); consider adding // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps and a short comment so future contributors don't reintroduce the bug by 'fixing' the lint warning.
Modal scrim <button onClick={onClose}> still uses the live prop (fine), but could also route through onCloseRef for consistency.
Main-site consultation/contact modals are not implemented via stays/ui.jsx Modal (no shared component found), so this fix does not affect them — no regression risk.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Focus-persistence fix verified. Tests performed: (1) mobile sheet typed 'jaip' + 2 backspaces, focus stayed on search-where-input every keystroke; (2) desktop /stays typed 'goa' + 2 backspaces, focus retained; (3) Escape and X close modal; (4) search flow -> /stays/search?where=Rajasthan navigates correctly. No regressions found.
rca of the issue: Original: Modal effect had deps [open, onClose]; inline onClose arrow in SearchBar was recreated on every setSearch re-render, retriggering effect cleanup which re-focused the previously-active element (sheet close button), stealing focus from the input after each keystroke. Fix: store onClose in a ref updated every render; keep effect deps [open] only. Verified working.
